newsitem.title: CANADA: George Weston rockets to near record high.
newsitem.headline: George Weston rockets to near record high.

text.p: Bakery and foodstuffs company George Weston Ltd shot up to near record highs in light trading on Thursday as investors reacted to mid-March news of a share buyback.
"I know that the company is doing very, very well," said ScotiaMcLeod's senior vice-president Fred Ketchen. "Keep in mind that they bought back a lot of stock."

Weston said on March 13 it intends to acquire up to 2.2 million shares or five percent of outstanding common shares. This should help improve its earnings figures since profits will be divided among fewer shares, Ketchen added.
Weston jumped 5.50 to 75.50 on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
The rally, Weston's biggest one-day move in years, pushed shares close to their February 3 life-time high of 76.95.
A company spokeswoman did not return calls.
Despite the surge, Weston's 71 percent owned supermarket chain operator Loblaw Cos Ltd traded flat at 17.10.
